articles.title: Lula alerta para possível especulação imobiliária em Itaparica, Bahia
articles.summary: President Lula participated in the ceremony marking the start of the Salvador-Itaparica Bridge construction, a R$ 11.6 billion infrastructure project part of the New PAC, while warning about potential real estate speculation that could affect island residents' quality of life.

articles.title: "Melhor arma que um país pode ter é alimento", diz Lula
articles.summary: President Lula launched the Harvest Plan for family farmers, announcing R$ 97.3 billion in credits and investments to strengthen food sovereignty and support agricultural diversification.
